Actually, reviewing transcript order: the agenda question comes before the location details are confirmed. However, rep immediately pivots to property details without waiting for elaboration on any concerns raised.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer says 'No' to concerns; no concerns raised, so N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Customer raised no concerns, so N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep covers property type (2-bed apartment, 1-bed apartment), floor/stories (second floor, first floor), number of rooms (2 bed + garage item), walking distance (50 feet parking to stairs, stairs to door), additional rooms (garage with tool cart), special considerations (tempered glass desk, flat-screen TV). Rep also explains the 2.5-hour minimum and 15-minute increment prorating: 'We have a minimum of two and a half hours once you go over that you will always be prorated into fifteen minute increment minutes.' Full transparency and commitment framing present.

evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep states 'we have on time guarantee we value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.' Covers the discount-if-late framing fully.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep states 'we have no worry damage coverage included on the early weight that you're paying us, we will provide up to 2000 dollars remove that is to repair, replace and reimburse for items.' States it's included (built into the rate), $2,000 coverage, and no-deductible framing is implied by 'included' language, though not explicitly stated as 'no fine print.' evidence_quotes.followup_on_remaining_concern: No final concerns check asked; customer does raise 'I'm still waiting on a couple of more estimates' as an objection, but rep does not dig in or follow up — just says 'Okay, no worries and I'll send you the email quotation.' N/A because it's not a concerns-check follow-up format.

If something comes up and change there's a change on your end then you can always reschedule or cancel with a quick call, no fees for that either.' This addresses no-deposit and cancellation flexibility; rate-lock (confirming the quote holds) is not explicitly mentioned by that term, but the no-change-fees language implies rate certainty. Marginal, but present.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Rep offers 'on the 5th of October we can be able to go ahead and schedule you as early as 8:30 AM to 9:00 AM' — date and arrival window confirmed. Customer does not confirm, only says 'I'm still waiting on a couple of more estimates.' Rep does not re-confirm phone number, arrival window lock, crew size (2 movers was stated in estimate but not re-confirmed as booking detail), addresses, or crew notes. Partial only.

top_strength: Comprehensive logistics and special-considerations gathering — the rep methodically confirmed property types, floor locations, walking distances, fragile items, and large furniture, then delivered a well-anchored and personalized estimate with full pricing transparency and fee clarity.
coaching_note: The critical gap is the absence of a genuine final concerns check (Section 6) and failure to ask 'Does that feel fair?' after the estimate (Section 4) — these two silences mean the rep never gave the customer a clear moment to voice remaining hesitation before the ask, which likely contributed to the objection 'I'm still waiting on more estimates' going unaddressed.
